features.qlooRankScore: 1 minus normalized Qloo list position (0 worst, 1 best)
features.densityUrban: 1 when site density is urban else 0
features.densitySuburban: 1 when site density is suburban else 0
features.densityExurban: 1 when site density is exurban else 0
features.densityTourist: 1 when site density is tourist else 0
